author: James Kelly
html: This was a refreshing take on AI in code reviews. Many discussions focus only on speed, but I appreciate how this article highlights the importance of maintaining code quality and developer accountability. AI is a great assistant, but thoughtful human review remains irreplaceable. Thanks for sharing these practical insights.
